# Engineering knowledge

[Project overview](../README.md) · [Documentation](../docs/README.md) · [Local design review](http://localhost:8765/site/)

Project-owned lessons that travel with the source and its review history.

Start with the [symptom index](SYMPTOM-INDEX.md) before investigating a known failure. Follow [Writing it down](WRITING-IT-DOWN.md) to record command/output evidence, cause, corrective rule and limits.

| Area | What belongs here |
|---|---|
| [Domains](domains/README.md) | Durable interface and engineering facts |
| [Playbooks](playbooks/README.md) | Repeatable build, validation and review procedures |
| [Issues](issues/README.md) | Recurring failure classes and diagnostic clues |
| [Inbox](inbox/README.md) | Dated incidents awaiting or supporting curation |

Lessons are published with the related fix through normal PR review. A local note is not a substitute for a regression check or a reviewed source change.
